title: Modal Verbs: Obligation, Advice & Degrees of Certainty
subtitle: CEFR B1–B2 • Must vs. Have To, Should/Ought To & Epistemic Deduction

topics.title: 1. Must vs. Have To (Rules & Necessity)
topics.subtitle: Internal Conviction vs. External Rules & No Obligation
topics.explanation: Keduanya berarti 'harus' dalam bentuk positif. Namun dalam bentuk negatif maknanya bertolak belakang total: 'mustn't' berarti DILARANG KERAS, sedangkan 'don't have to' berarti TIDAK WAJIB (opsional).
topics.rationale: Membedakan larangan keras dengan kebebasan memilih sangat krusial dalam instruksi kerja dan aturan keselamatan.

formulas.pattern: Subject + must / have to / has to + Verb-1
mustn't + V1 (Prohibited)  |  don't/doesn't have to + V1 (Optional)
Do / Does + Subject + have to + Verb-1?

conditionalExamples.positive: You must encrypt API keys, and we have to submit reports by Friday.
conditionalExamples.negative: You mustn't commit .env files, though you don't have to attend optional syncs.
conditionalExamples.question: Do we have to wear formal attire on Fridays?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: 'Mustn't' = dilarang melakukannya; 'don't have to' = boleh dilakukan kalau mau, tidak dilakukan juga tidak apa-apa.

specialExceptions.title: Bentuk Lampau 'Must' Adalah 'Had To'
specialExceptions.explanation: 'Must' tidak punya bentuk lampau. Untuk menyatakan keharusan di masa lalu, gunakan 'had to + V1'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: Yesterday I musted stay late to fix a bug.
specialExceptions.correctExample: Yesterday I had to stay late to fix a bug.

tipsAndTricks: Modal verb (must, should, can, could, might) selalu diikuti Verb-1 murni tanpa 'to' dan tanpa '-s' (she must go, bukan she musts goes).

topics.title: 2. Should & Had Better (Advice & Warnings)
topics.subtitle: Constructive Suggestions vs. Urgent Consequence Warnings
topics.explanation: 'Should' dipakai untuk saran baik yang sopan dan logis. 'Had better' dipakai untuk saran mendesak yang jika diabaikan akan menimbulkan konsekuensi buruk.
topics.rationale: Dalam diskusi tim, memakai 'should' atau 'could' terdengar kolaboratif dan tidak menggurui rekan kerja.

formulas.pattern: Subject + should / had better ('d better) + Verb-1
Subject + shouldn't / had better not + Verb-1

conditionalExamples.positive: We should add unit tests, and you'd better back up the database first.
conditionalExamples.negative: You shouldn't ignore TypeScript warnings in strict mode.
conditionalExamples.question: Should we schedule a quick call to align on the schema?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: 'You'd better' terdengar tegas dan mendesak—gunakan hanya saat ada risiko nyata jika tidak dilakukan.

xrayTokens.nuance: Saran teknis yang konstruktif dan profesional

specialExceptions.title: Bentuk Negatif 'Had Better' Adalah 'Had Better Not'
specialExceptions.wrongExample: You hadn't better deploy without testing.
specialExceptions.correctExample: You'd better not deploy without testing.

tipsAndTricks: Untuk memberi masukan yang lebih lembut di rapat, awali dengan 'Maybe we should...' atau 'I think we should...'.

topics.title: 3. Must, Might, Could, Can't (Logical Deduction)
topics.subtitle: Expressing Certainty & Possibility Based on Evidence
topics.explanation: Digunakan untuk menebak atau menyimpulkan situasi berdasarkan bukti: 'must' (95% yakin benar), 'might/may/could' (50% mungkin), dan 'can't' (95% yakin mustahil).
topics.rationale: Dalam troubleshooting teknis maupun diskusi sehari-hari, kita jarang 100% tahu penyebab masalah sebelum investigasi—modal deduction menunjukkan tingkat keyakinan kita secara akurat.

formulas.pattern: Subject + must / might / could + [Be + Adj / Verb-1]
Subject + can't / might not + [Be + Adj / Verb-1]

conditionalExamples.positive: The server returns 401, so the token must be expired or it might be invalid.
conditionalExamples.negative: It can't be a database issue because read queries are still fast.
conditionalExamples.question: Could the CORS policy be blocking the request?
conditionalExamples.nuanceNote: Lawan kata dari 'must be' dalam tebakan logis adalah 'can't be' (bukan 'mustn't be').

xrayTokens.nuance: Kesimpulan logis kuat berdasarkan kode error 401

specialExceptions.title: Lawan dari Tebakan 'Must Be' Adalah 'Can't Be'
specialExceptions.explanation: Ketika yakin sesuatu tidak mungkin terjadi berdasarkan bukti, gunakan 'can't be'.
specialExceptions.wrongExample: He just left 2 minutes ago; he mustn't be home yet.
specialExceptions.correctExample: He just left 2 minutes ago; he can't be home yet.

tipsAndTricks: Skala keyakinan cepat: Must (pasti) → Should (kemungkinan besar) → Might/Could (mungkin saja) → Can't (mustahil).

scenario.interlocutor: Rekan baru bertanya apakah ia wajib hadir di sesi coffee chat santai hari Jumat
scenario.intent: Menjelaskan bahwa sesi tersebut bersifat sukarela (tidak wajib).

practiceQuiz.question: Jawaban mana yang menyampaikan maksud 'tidak wajib' dengan benar?

options.text: You mustn't join the Friday coffee chat.
You don't have to join the Friday coffee chat—it's totally optional.
You haven't to join the Friday coffee chat.

deepExplanation.whyCorrect: 'Don't have to' berarti tidak ada keharusan (opsional).
deepExplanation.whyOthersFail: 'Mustn't' berarti dilarang keras (seolah dia tidak boleh ikut), sedangkan 'haven't to' tidak gramatikal dalam konteks ini.
deepExplanation.realLifeHack: Ganti 'don't have to' dengan 'don't need to' jika ingin terdengar lebih ringan.
